items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: His name was Fitzgerald. I'll never forget it. Ed Fitzgerald, an Irishman. He was beautiful. A senior citizen. He drove me all the way from Texas to New York.

ctx.x: Earl and the two trombones, that was Bob and Ed, three trumpets, four saxes, and four rhythm.
Would it be possible for you to name the fellows that were playing in the band? Is that feasible?
